name: Gila Monster

review.observation: Full original: dense black-and-orange beadlike skin pattern, blunt heavy head, thick short neck, fat banded tail and four clawed feet. Distinct paired orange/black pigment pattern is visible. Far proximal limbs remain body-occluded; exact toe count unconfirmed. Broad margins and continuous tail.

decisions.paintingObservation: No paired projecting mammalian pinnae are depicted. Any ear opening, tympanum, protective ear flap, casque, horn, neck frill or external gill remains natural head/neck paint; none is a substitute pinna.

policyStatus: AUDIT_ONLY_CANDIDATE: production reviewed-presence.mjs still admits tail absence only.
